could_this_be_cooler:
The Magic Bounce and Dancer ideas are both good and I agree they should be retained, but playing it exposes a structural problem the dossier does not mention: all four of Colin's members are Flying types, and three of the four are Psychic/Flying. One spread Rock Slide from one Pokemon was super effective against the entire trainer, every turn, and it won the fight in three turns without costing me a single Pokemon. That is not a level problem - raising the offsets just means the same Rock Slide takes four turns instead of three. The fix is one non-Flying body, and Colin's own theme supplies the obvious candidate: Oricorio has four forms, and Oricorio-Baile (Fire/Flying) or Oricorio-Sensu (Ghost/Flying) would keep the dancer concept while... those are still Flying. The honest answer is that a bird keeper whose entire roster shares a 2x Rock weakness needs either a Rock-resistant partner (a Steel/Flying like Skarmory, which resists Rock outright) or one member that is simply not a bird. I would add Skarmory: it resists Rock, it keeps the theme perfectly, and Sturdy plus Magic Bounce is a far more annoying support pair than Dodrio contributes. Flagged, not changed.

Second note, on Dancer: the dossier already identifies that Dancer has nothing to copy, and I can now confirm it is a blank ability against a party that does not set up. Giving Oricorio's partner a dance move of its own - Xatu cannot learn one, but Dodrio has no useful fourth slot - would make Dancer fire on Colin's own terms rather than only as a punish.
